import struct
data = open("dump.zip", "rb").read()
n = len(data)
off = 0
entries = []
while off + 30 <= n:
    sig = data[off:off+4]
    if sig != b'PK\x03\x04':
        print("not LFH at", off, sig.hex())
        break
    (sigv, ver, flags, comp, mtime, mdate, crc, csize, usize, nlen, elen) = struct.unpack('<4sHHHHHIIIHH', data[off:off+30])
    name = data[off+30:off+30+nlen]
    extra = data[off+30+nlen:off+30+nlen+elen]
    cstart = off+30+nlen+elen
    entries.append((name, flags, comp, crc, csize, usize, extra, cstart))
    print("LFH:", name, "flags=%x comp=%d crc=%08x csize=%d usize=%d extra=%s" % (flags, comp, crc, csize, usize, extra.hex()))
    off = cstart + csize
print("total entries:", len(entries))
print("remaining tail:", data[off:off+16].hex(), "tail len:", n-off)

data = open("dump.zip", "rb").read()
n = len(data)
def u16(b, o): return int.from_bytes(b[o:o+2], 'little')
def u32(b, o): return int.from_bytes(b[o:o+4], 'little')

off = 0
entries = []
while off + 30 <= n:
    if data[off:off+4] != b'PK\x03\x04':
        print("not LFH at", off, data[off:off+4].hex())
        break
    ver = u16(data, off+4)
    flags = u16(data, off+6)
    comp = u16(data, off+8)
    crc = u32(data, off+14)
    csize = u32(data, off+18)
    usize = u32(data, off+22)
    nlen = u16(data, off+26)
    elen = u16(data, off+28)
    name = data[off+30:off+30+nlen]
    extra = data[off+30+nlen:off+30+nlen+elen]
    cstart = off+30+nlen+elen
    entries.append(dict(name=name, flags=flags, comp=comp, crc=crc, csize=csize, usize=usize, extra=extra, cstart=cstart))
    print("LFH:", name, "flags=%x comp=%d crc=%08x csize=%d usize=%d extra=%s" % (flags, comp, crc, csize, usize, extra.hex()))
    off = cstart + csize
print("total entries:", len(entries))
print("remaining tail len:", n-off)
print("tail:", data[off:off+40].hex())
